Chapter 7054: Enforcer’S Tribulation Ocean

Chapter 7054: Enforcer’s Tribulation Ocean

Everyone was surprised to see a celestial immortal accepting defeat and running away.

“Let’s see where you can hide.” Li Qiye smiled and gave chase.

Zhao Dachui’s speed was impeccable but there was only one possible path. Of course, Li Qiye was still faster.

The crowd also wanted to give chase to watch. After all, none could open the dao court. A show was better than nothing. Moreover, they were curious about Zhao Dachui’s current state.

“Stop, don’t go.” One immortal shouted.

“Right, the enforcer’s tribulation ocean.” A golden immortal agreed and stopped.

“That’s the battlefield back then?” An overlord asked.

“All of Ruin was the battlefield. Where we are is the core, the outer areas have been obliterated.” The golden immortal said.

Thus, they stopped and observed from afar. They saw a void with nothing but tribulations. Each drop could kill an overlord instantly.

“How many tribulations descended back then?” An immortal asked.

“The momentum must have been amazing too.” Heaven’s Equal said since this was the only way for the combatants to survive the tribulations.

Unfortunately, the enforcer’s tribulations surpassed expectations. The core of Heaven Pit was now engulfed in her tribulations.

However, the most terrifying thing was the indelible scar sliced by her slash. This would last for eternity.

“That’s the slash.” Everyone shuddered while staring at it since they could still sense the remnant sharpness.

Heaven’s Equal stared at the scar while rejoicing in the fact that he didn’t participate in Heaven Pit. As far as the public knew, all the celestial immortals died except Heavenfall; other immortals were reduced to dust.

Despite not participating, everyone could envision an ultimate slash putting a decisive end to the battle.

“How terrifying.” An overlord stared at the scar in horror.

Meanwhile, Li Qiye had made it to the center of the ocean while Zhao Dachui dived in headfirst.

“You’re not leaving this place alive.” His head remained above the surface as he threatened.

“You will kill me?” Li Qiye smiled.

All eyes were watching Li Qiye leisurely strolling among the ocean. If the tribulations were to go wild, not even a celestial immortal could last too long without escaping.
